A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ImAge research and contain readable main text, equations, Tables 1–10, Figures 1–8, and Appendices A–K. No material gaps prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original VPR benchmark evaluations, token ablations, qualitative results, and appendix experiments with alternative backbones and computational efficiency.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendices D–H, including benchmark scores, ablations, efficiency measurements, and failure cases.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.4 retain the same aggregation-token insertion strategy, L2-normalized k-means initialization, backbone self-attention, and descriptor construction. No algorithmic component or training objective changes.

E1.justification: Training sources and evaluation coverage remain unchanged, including Pitts30k, MSLS, Tokyo24/7, Nordland, Baidu Mall, SPED, Pitts250k, St. Lucia, and SVOX. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the main comparisons, appendix experiments, and qualitative examples. The newly cited VPR-Cloak work is not evaluated as a baseline; changed citation numbers refer to the same existing comparators.

E3.justification: Recall@N metrics and matching thresholds, dataset splits and sample counts, image resolutions, backbone configurations, and training settings remain identical in Section 4, Table 8, and Appendix I.

E4.justification: The insertion, initialization, and token-count ablations in Tables 5–7 are unchanged. Appendices D–H retain the same alternative-backbone experiments, efficiency analyses, attention visualizations, qualitative examples, and failure cases.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Statistical reporting practices do not change.

E6.justification: Numerical results in Tables 2–10 and the figures are unchanged, as are qualitative findings. For example, Table 2 reports ImAge MSLS-challenge Recall@1/5/10 of 84.5/93.8/95.4 in both versions.

T1.justification: The ViT update equations, attention definition, and aggregation-token attention expansion in Equations 1–3 are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about implicit aggregation without a separate aggregator, token insertion and initialization, competitive accuracy and efficiency, and first place on the MSLS leaderboard.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and result interpretations are unchanged. Appendix B retains the same limitations concerning pretraining scale, backbone fine-tuning, and unexplored applications; Appendices G–H retain the same attention interpretations and failure analysis.

D1.justification: Hardware, PyTorch implementation, hyperparameters, data organization, alternative-backbone settings, and comparator configurations remain unchanged. Both versions provide the same code-access link.

R1.justification: v2 adds Dong et al.'s VPR-Cloak: A First Look at Privacy Cloak against Visual Place Recognition as reference 22, citing it in Section 2's general list of deep-feature VPR research. Existing comparisons and novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits comprise the added citation and bibliography entry, consequent reference renumbering, minor bibliographic spacing, and the updated arXiv version/date stamp. Scientific prose and section organization are otherwise unchanged.

P2.justification: The added reference causes limited bibliography reflow across pages 12–15. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–10 retain their designs, contents, and placement apart from updated citation numbers.

improvement.justification: v2 adds one citation to an existing related-work list, with accompanying numbering and layout changes. The method, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
